## Overview
Shaikh Hunain is an AI & Systems Engineer pursuing his B.Tech in Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence at Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT), Pune (2024–Present). He specializes in machine learning pipelines, explainable AI, computer vision, autonomous robotics, and high-performance web systems.

## Key Projects & Engineering Systems
1. **SARAS — Smart Autonomous Robotic AI System**:
   - Autonomous robotics system integrating voice interaction, computer vision, and navigation using Raspberry Pi, ROS, and multimodal AI perception.
   - Repository: https://github.com/NotArsal/SARAS

2. **FormBhar — AI Google Forms Auto-Filler**:
   - Production Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) with Express backend, Supabase PostgreSQL, and multi-model AI engine (OpenAI GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Claude 3) for multi-page automated form reasoning.
   - Repository: https://github.com/NotArsal/FormBhar

3. **Tomato — Full Stack Food Delivery Platform**:
   - MERN application with real-time Socket.io delivery partner tracking, 3-role authentication, and Leaflet.js geospatial restaurant discovery for Pune.
   - Repository: https://github.com/NotArsal/Tomato
   - Live URL: https://tomato-frontend-seven.vercel.app

4. **PhysioTracker — AI Posture & Rep Counter**:
   - Real-time posture correction system using MediaPipe 33-keypoint tracking and BiLSTM exercise sequence classification delivering sub-100ms inference latency.
   - Repository: https://github.com/NotArsal/Physiotherapy
   - Live URL: https://physiotherapy-frotend.vercel.app

5. **Solar Grievance Management System**:
   - Industry-sponsored platform developed for Nature Tek Solar Pvt. Ltd. (under Prof. Archana Burujwale) for complaint registration, ticket tracking, and resolution handling.
   - Repository: https://github.com/NotArsal/Solar-Customer-Grievance-Management-System
   - Live URL: https://industryproject-frontend.vercel.app

6. **Shortest Path Algorithm Simulator**:
   - Interactive road network visualizer executing Dijkstra, A*, Bellman-Ford, and Floyd-Warshall on real Pune city OpenStreetMap data.
   - Repository: https://github.com/NotArsal/algorithm-Simulator
